description: Human reference for four original English passages. Gold is not model input. Restatements in the later paragraphs are the same claims, not extra ones.

claims.source_quote: Harbor Lab posted its Harbor-Math report on March 4, 2024.
claims.normalized_claim: Harbor Lab posted its Harbor-Math report on March 4, 2024.

claims.source_quote: Model X scored 62% on Harbor-Math
claims.normalized_claim: Model X scored 62% on Harbor-Math.

claims.source_quote: the March 2024 standard tier costs $5 per million tokens
claims.normalized_claim: On the March 2024 list, the standard tier costs $5 per million tokens.

claims.source_quote: The same report lists the human baseline for that exam at 55%.
claims.normalized_claim: The human baseline for Harbor-Math is 55%.

claims.source_quote: the paper does not report results on other reasoning tasks
claims.normalized_claim: The paper does not report results on other reasoning tasks.

claims.source_quote: I think Harbor-Math is the only benchmark that matters this year.
claims.normalized_claim: The writer thinks Harbor-Math is the only benchmark that matters this year.

claims.source_quote: By 2027, Model X will outperform every graduate program on campus.
claims.normalized_claim: By 2027, Model X will outperform every graduate program on campus.

claims.source_quote: A few headlines called the gain "twice as good," but the report never names the system that phrase is comparing against.
claims.normalized_claim: Headlines called the gain twice as good, but the report does not name the comparison system.
missing_context: which system the gain is compared with

claims.source_quote: On November 1, 2024, Acme's public price list set the standard-tier API at $8 per million tokens.
claims.normalized_claim: On November 1, 2024, Acme's standard-tier API was listed at $8 per million tokens.

claims.source_quote: the batch tier remained $3 per million tokens on that date
claims.normalized_claim: On November 1, 2024, Acme's batch tier remained $3 per million tokens.

claims.source_quote: the change is still cheaper than before
claims.normalized_claim: The author says the change is cheaper than before, without stating the earlier price.

claims.source_quote: I find the standard tier too expensive for student projects.
claims.normalized_claim: The writer finds the standard tier too expensive for student projects.

claims.source_quote: Acme will cut the standard tier below $1 per million tokens in 2026.
claims.normalized_claim: Acme will cut the standard tier below $1 per million tokens in 2026.

claims.source_quote: 40% of pull requests on the payments team were drafted by the assistant
claims.normalized_claim: In Q2 2025, 40% of pull requests on the payments team were drafted by the assistant.

claims.source_quote: 12% of incidents on that team were opened by the assistant during Q2 2025
claims.normalized_claim: During Q2 2025, 12% of incidents on the payments team were opened by the assistant.

claims.source_quote: human engineers are no longer needed
claims.normalized_claim: The writer concludes that human engineers are no longer needed.

claims.source_quote: Next year, the assistant will draft 90% of pull requests across the whole company.
claims.normalized_claim: Next year, the assistant will draft 90% of pull requests across the whole company.

claims.source_quote: On January 15, 2025, Lumen Clinic published a policy that requires a human clinician to review any medical answer from its chatbot before the answer is sent to a patient.
claims.normalized_claim: On January 15, 2025, Lumen Clinic required a human clinician to review any medical answer its chatbot would send to a patient.

claims.source_quote: The policy applies to the patient-facing chatbot named Lumen Guide.
claims.normalized_claim: The policy applies to the patient-facing chatbot named Lumen Guide.

claims.source_quote: accuracy rose by 10 points
claims.normalized_claim: The page says accuracy rose by 10 points, without naming the test or the earlier score.

claims.source_quote: I believe the review rule is the right tradeoff.
claims.normalized_claim: The writer believes the review rule is the right tradeoff.

claims.source_quote: Regulators will ban unreviewed medical chatbots in 2026.
claims.normalized_claim: Regulators will ban unreviewed medical chatbots in 2026.
